CustomField.description: When checked, published AIPlatformLogEvent__e events are written to AIPlatformLog__c records. Unchecked, the events are dropped and no AIPlatformLog__c records are created org-wide.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use with caution - turning this off removes visibility into failures across the whole application until turned back on.
CustomField.label: Is Platform Logging Enabled
